_comment: Class-tuning passes applied to the Midnight 12.1 PTR, newest first.
The dashboard's 'Since latest tuning' filter compares each run's exact
start instant (epoch ms, UTC) against the cutoff for the region whose PTR
realm the run was played on, so a run counts only once tuning was live
for it. Add a new entry at the TOP after each pass — the dashboard and the
'regions' maps a WCL region code to the ISO8601 UTC instant tuning went
live there; 'default' covers every region not listed. Per-region keys are
supported but currently unused on purpose - see the note below.

patches.label: Curse of Ula'tek PTR class tuning (Jul 31)
patches.note: Anchored on the moment Blizzard published the notes. Blizzard announced no PTR restart or go-live time for this pass, so the publication instant is the best sourced anchor rather than a stated deployment time.
patches.why_not_per_region: Patch 12.1 hit its release candidate build (68914, Jul 24), after which tuning ships as server-side hotfixes applied globally rather than via per-region realm restarts. The EU notes were mirrored 26 seconds after the US post, and no source publishes separate regional deployment times, so per-region cutoffs would be false precision.
patches.robustness: The cutoff falls in a 38-minute window with no logged runs (nearest run before 18:34:57Z, nearest after 19:13:06Z). Moving the assumed go-live by +/-30 min reclassifies only 2 runs, and by +/-1 h at most 10, so the split is insensitive to the exact minute.
